observation.prompt: Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Extract each distinct remuneration-for-service event with its literal payer, payee, amount, stated service kind, inclusive service-period endpoints, and separately stated payment date. A service period is not a payment date: when the complete text gives no payment date, use null while keeping the view complete; use unread or failed only for an uninspected or ambiguous channel. Preserve exact nonempty verbatim witnesses. A complete finite read may contain no payment events. Do not infer wages, allocate a cross-year amount, apply an employer threshold, classify the final legal claim, or copy the target query as a fact.

Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Extract annual income records, directed marriage records, actual joint or separate return statements, and explicit positive or negative section 151 allowance givens. A section 151(b) record is taxpayer-to-spouse and a section 151(c) record is taxpayer-to-dependent; preserve polarity and never use the target section 63 query as its own given. Use a subtype only when the text and witnessed factual role support it; otherwise mark the channel unread or provide separate coherent views. Represent 'has been married since D' as ongoing_since, a bare commencement as onset_only, and an expressly bounded marriage as closed_interval. For every channel, complete means the entire finite supplied text was inspected, so [] means no matching statement; unread or failed is not an empty negative. Attach exact nonempty current witnesses. Do not calculate the deduction limit or provide a native answer.

Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Extract directed marriage records and actual death records with canonical dates. Represent continuing wording such as 'has been married since D' as ongoing_since, a bare commencement as onset_only, and an expressly bounded marriage as closed_interval. A matching stated spouse death may close an explicitly ongoing marriage on the death date; do not otherwise invent an endpoint or extend a bare onset into a future state. For each channel, complete means the complete finite supplied text was inspected, so [] records completed source absence; unread or failed records extraction uncertainty. Attach exact nonempty verbatim witnesses. Do not evaluate the two-year statutory window, infer surviving-spouse status, or provide a final answer.

Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Extract witnessed service records with literal worker and employing institution, educational-institution classifications, enrollment records, and regular-class-attendance records. Enrollment and attendance must retain their own institution identifiers so the fixed program can test whether they concern the same school, college, or university as the employer. For enrollment and attendance use ongoing_since only for expressly continuing wording, closed_interval for two supported endpoints, active_on_date for an explicit dated status, and onset_only for a bare commencement whose persistence is not established. For every channel, complete means the entire finite supplied text was inspected, so [] is completed source absence; unread or failed is extraction uncertainty. Attach exact nonempty verbatim witnesses. Do not infer that two institutions are identical, turn onset into permanent status, determine the exception, or provide a final answer.

value.rationale: 四个合同只学习源原生事实表示及其到作者固定事实接口的降级，不修改或复制法条程序。general_employer 以旧 payment-event 组件为真实父组件，继续复用 payer/payee、服务种类、金额和服务期间，但新增“付款日期已陈述／完整读取后未陈述／未读”的区分；降级时为服务和付款建立不同事件根，绝不把服务期间冒充付款日期，直接修复错误事件角色。dependent_basic_deduction_limit 复用旧婚姻持续状态和有向给定的转换方式，新增年度收入及带极性的 section 151 给定，并用去重、定型的原生事实消除错误元数和重复截断。surviving_spouse_death_window 复用 ongoing_since 与 onset_only 的区别，新增配偶死亡事件；明确持续的婚姻可在已述死亡日闭合，单纯起始事件不会被扩展到任意未来。student_service_exception 是无相关错误回合的新原语，故 parent=null、error_feedback_ids=[]；它新增服务机构、教育机构、入学和到课记录，并通过同一 institution 值保持“在同一机构”约束。所有适配器仅把有当前逐字证据的记录转换为 typed primitives；完整来源缺失由 complete+空记录表达，未读或歧义保持 unread/unresolved，多种连贯视图全部交给固定程序执行。
